training_target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

input_priority.policy: Side: q0 primary; flexion/extension: q1/q2/q3 primary. Soft preference, not a guaranteed derivative ratio.

side_motor_mapping: q0-only anchor plus bending correction; negative correction smoothly bounded, positive payout preserved
training_scope: Formal full (thumb) or xy (other fingers), including movement timeouts; ring point_id<2214
fit_limitation: Validation is raw recorded motor feedback, NOT rebased motor-zero control accuracy or hardware tracking. Reference can lie outside sampled poses; neutral subtraction does not calibrate physical zero. No robot test or closed-loop q control performed. Ring uses four same-session targets from ring_data, whereas the current polynomial uses older extensor/flexor data.
control_policy_validation_note: New M10/M17 held-out raw-feedback metrics fit each outer training fold only. Architecture selection is not independent final testing. Side metrics inherited; no hardware tension claim.

preserved_outputs.note: All side networks, side normalization, 2deg policy, reference and controller limits copied

side_structure.raw_prediction: signed_monotonic_h(q0) + learned_c(q1,q2,q3); M22 c is nondecreasing in q1
side_structure.guarantee: M22 is nonincreasing and M21 nondecreasing in q0, including after the side policy. Bending correction is independent of q0. No amplitude or hardware tracking guarantee.

22.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on original rows
22.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

21.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on original rows
21.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

joint_antagonistic_structure.feature_connections: First-layer concave units omit q1; M17 reads second-layer Softplus units; M10 can read all shared features
joint_antagonistic_structure.guarantee: M17 winding is nondecreasing and has a nondecreasing slope along q1 at fixed other inputs. No amplitude or tension guarantee.

joint_pair_training.selection: Fixed 3000-epoch candidate after structural screening; grouped results used for model selection, not independent final test

extensor_training.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on all original rows
extensor_training.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

flexor_training.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; final fit on original rows
flexor_training.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees

side_bending_refinement_training.validation_note: Candidate-selection validation; each base q0 rebuilt on outer training rows. Not an independent final test.

side_training_scope: Base q0/side fit; current M22 bending-only stage is in side_bending_refinement_training

extensor_readout_training.boundary_definition: delta q1 OR q3 >= training-fold 80th percentile; original rows only
extensor_readout_training.selection: Fixed readout epochs; candidate-comparison validation, not independent final test

previous_joint_pair_training.paired_precision_definition: Training-fold standardized measured-label covariance plus 0.02 diagonal; inverse normalized to trace 2
previous_joint_pair_training.selection: Median inner-selected epochs from five outer pose folds; early stop scores validation pair error plus output-feature coordination penalty
previous_joint_pair_training.target_definition: Unchanged recorded motor feedback positions in degrees
